title: Level 1 (Beginner) - A-19
notes:
West leads the ♠10 against 6NT. East takes the ♠A at trick 1 and returns the suit. South has 11 top tricks (2 spades, 3 hearts, 2 diamonds, and 4 clubs).

The only suit that offers a chance for trick 12 is diamonds. South must take a trick with dummy's ♦10. South can succeed via a double finesse if West has both the ♦Q and ♦J. South should lead a diamond towards North. If West follows low, the ♦10 is played. If West plays the ♦J or ♦Q, North wins the trick. South travels back to his hand and leads another diamond towards North, again planning to play the ♦10 if West follows low.

South should make sure not to cash too many tricks before playing diamonds. Diamonds will have to be played twice from the South hand.
